scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev --workspace @credence/api" "npm run dev --workspace @credence/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @credence/shared && npm run build --workspace @credence/api && npm run build --workspace @credence/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @credence/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @credence/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @credence/web
